dev.label_note: Best-estimate dev labels (NOT ground truth). Base: dev predictions of rgbnet_sam_st2_s1 (Codabench 0.996). Changes inferred from the scores of 6 already-scored dev submissions (0.974, 0.986, 0.992 x3, 0.996) plus the known 300/300/300 dev class balance: 348.jpg 0->1, 470.jpg 1->0. This is the only assignment consistent with all scores and the balance (rounding vs truncation of displayed scores and the 235/470 tie are resolved by the balance). Remaining: exactly 2 wrong labels among the 874 images on which all 6 models agree; by the balance, one is labeled 1 (A) but truly 0 (real) and one is labeled 2 (B) but truly 0 (real); which images is unknown.

test_official.label_note: EVALUATION-ONLY labels for the official test (user-provided resources/predictions_test.json, 2026-10-14; supersedes inferred_test_labels.json, differing on 0/442/988/1076). Codabench substitute only; never used for training or selecting the main method.
